methodology: Eight isolated deterministic scenarios use the real kernel, device signatures and gateway. The five-candidate comparison replays recorded pre-authorization gates (confirmation answers assumed yes); it does not execute a weakened bank. The verifier is an offline shared parser. No live-model accuracy, user friction or population failure rate is measured. Faults and the secondary-review fixture clock are injected only in fresh sandboxes.
